design: One deterministic prefix-only controller. At checkpoints 100,140,180,220,240 compute trend with trailing up-to-100 HAC3; for n<240 commit direction if classified at z=4*(4.327111573414373), otherwise observe; at 240 classify using z=4.327111573414373, commit if directional or zero, else abstain. Earliest allowed commit wins. No future observations accessed until time n.
decision_order: On each prefix exactly one action, with deterministic classification and observation deadline; compare final-only action from SG052 on same streams.

pilot.disclosure: Pilot inspected and multiple thresholds tried before freeze. Fixed conservative multiplier 4 chosen to test rare early commitment. It is still inferior to waiting on the pilot; no holdout tuning.

safety_checks: No final observation read before checkpoint
Zero output differences on modified unseen future
Correct count, wrong count, abstentions, sample budget and modeled loss reported
If early action adds loss, reject action policy rather than declaring success
limits: The threshold was selected after looking at one pilot; validation is solely the heldout seed batch.
Early checkpoint labels compared with ultimate postchange target even when transition has not occurred yet; this penalizes premature commitment appropriately.
Known synthetic generators, not real-world deployment.
